7351.title: Hover-only dismissal overrides keyboard submenu activation
7351.rootCauseOneLine: The submenu's hover-loss effect closes keyboard-opened content because keyboard activation never establishes pointer-hover ownership.
7351.proposedFix: Limit hover-loss dismissal to hover activation; keep explicit click and keyboard opens alive and retain existing close/focus behavior.
7351.caveats: Real component browser fixture plus full-picker jsdom tests; no server-backed application, Safari, mobile, or live provider run.
